groundTruth.description: The Favorites view must not recommend opening the Favorites view itself.

hypotheses.title: Navigation to 'Favoritos' does not lead to a page with any content.
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The 'Favoritos' section shows an empty state message and no products or additional content.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: When navigating to the 'Favoritos' section, it should display a list of saved items or a prompt for adding new favorites.
hypotheses.oracle: The QA professional should check if there is any backend logic that populates this page with user's favorite products.

hypotheses.title: Navigation to 'Favoritos' does not reflect the current active view.
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The navigation bar still shows other sections like 'Início', 'Comidas', and 'Pedidos'.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: After navigating to 'Favoritos', it should be the only visible section in the navigation bar, reflecting that this is the currently active view.
hypotheses.oracle: The QA professional should verify if there are any JavaScript or CSS changes needed to update the navigation bar when navigating to 'Favoritos'.

hypotheses.title: Navigation to 'Favoritos' does not provide clear calls-to-action.
hypotheses.observedEvidence: There is a button labeled 'Explorar a vitrine', which seems out of place in this section and does not clearly indicate what action should be taken next.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: The page should have clear, actionable buttons or links that guide the user to add items to their favorites or explore more options within the 'Favoritos' section.
hypotheses.oracle: The QA professional should check if there are any missing calls-to-action or if the current button is misleading.

reviews.title: Navigation to 'Favoritos' does not lead to a page with any content.
reviews.reason: The observed evidence matches the expected behavior of an empty state message and no products or additional content, indicating that there is no backend logic populating this page with user's favorite products.

reviews.title: Navigation to 'Favoritos' does not reflect the current active view.
reviews.reason: The observed evidence shows that other sections like 'Início', 'Comidas', and 'Pedidos' are still visible in the navigation bar, which aligns with the expected behavior of it being the only visible section when navigating to 'Favoritos'.

reviews.title: Navigation to 'Favoritos' does not provide clear calls-to-action.
reviews.reason: The observed evidence indicates that the button labeled 'Explorar a vitrine' is out of place and does not clearly indicate what action should be taken next, which aligns with the expected behavior of having clear actionable buttons or links within this section.
